column1: # Mixin members that would clash once every member prefix is `sparkdlc$`. Every other member only changes its prefix. `plan` fails when two
# members that are different today would get one name; the fix is a row here with an explicit new name, never an old prefix.
# 所有成员前缀统一为 `sparkdlc$` 后会冲突的 mixin 成员。其余成员只改前缀。今天不同的两个成员会得到同一个名字时 `plan` 失败；
# 解决办法是在这里加一行并给出明确的新名字，绝不保留旧前缀。
